result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Company may assign without consent to affiliates and transaction successors; Contractor assignments remain subject to Company’s consent, not unreasonably withheld, and assignments to Company competitors are prohibited; and Company change of control creates no Contractor termination right. Unrelated transfer and subcontracting restrictions remain intact. It is not strictly minimal because it additionally covers reorganizations and prohibits suspension and repricing—protections beyond the stated playbook requirement—and extends the change-of-control protection expressly to Statements of Work. The drafting is otherwise clear and professional.
